blocks.x: Quantum & Advanced Compute applied to Capabilities. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

In Manufacturing & Industrial, quantum & advanced compute is the frontier tower, run with a pragmatist's discipline. That is the baseline pattern; the differentiator is what it connects to: quantum readiness & strategy, quantum optimization for enterprise problems, post-quantum cryptography migration — delivered on Dataq Quanta and Dataq Sentinel with the sector's regulatory posture built in.

items: Scheduling at combinatorial scale
Job-shop scheduling and changeover optimization hit classical solver ceilings at plant complexity; better sequences are left on the table.
Brownfield instrumentation gap
Critical assets run uninstrumented because gut-and-replace is unthinkable; the data that twins and models need does not exist, and downtime for retrofit is unaffordable.
Quality escapes and manual inspection

Defect detection depends on sampling and eyes; escapes reach customers, and scrap/rework costs hide in the P&L. Vision systems stall in pilot because lighting, thresholds and line integration were never engineered.

blocks.x: Two regimes anchor the control design here: Sector export-control and dual-use rules and Sector export-control and dual-use rules. Engineering data governance where applicable. Evidence for both is generated by the delivery itself — control tests, replay trails and documentation are artifacts of the program, not a reconstruction project.

Programs run on a fixed rhythm so progress is visible from week one. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
